test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

________ months later, Steve returned to New York to look for a job.
solution:
The correct answer is "**A few.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us understand the usage of the following:
 
 
• **A little and a few are quantifiers meaning ‘some’. **
 
• We use a little with singular uncountable nouns. We use a few&n
